original_english: Living organisms are well-organised structures; they can have tissues, tissues have cells, cells have smaller components in them.
hinglish_roman: Living organisms bahut well-organised structures hote hain; unme tissues ho sakte hain, tissues mein cells hote hain, aur cells mein smaller components hote hain.

original_english: The processes which together perform the maintenance job are called life processes.
hinglish_roman: Jo processes milke maintenance ka kaam karte hain, unhe life processes kehte hain.

original_english: Energy is needed for maintenance processes; this energy comes from outside the body of the individual organism.
hinglish_roman: Maintenance processes ke liye energy chahiye hoti hai; yeh energy organism ke body ke bahar se aati hai.

original_english: Autotrophs include green plants and some bacteria that use simple food material from inorganic sources.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs mein green plants aur kuch bacteria aate hain jo inorganic sources se simple food material use karte hain.

original_english: Photosynthesis is the process by which autotrophs take in substances from the outside and convert them into stored forms of energy.
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis woh process hai jiske zariye autotrophs bahar se substances lete hain aur unhe stored energy ke form mein convert karte hain.

original_english: Carbon dioxide and water are converted into carbohydrates in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll.
hinglish_roman: Carbon dioxide aur water, sunlight aur chlorophyll ki presence mein carbohydrates mein convert ho jaate hain.

original_english: Stomata are tiny pores present on the surface of the leaves through which massive amounts of gaseous exchange takes place.
hinglish_roman: Stomata patti ki surface par maujood tiny pores hote hain jinke zariye badi matra mein gaseous exchange hoti hai.

original_english: The opening and closing of the stomatal pore is a function of the guard cells.
hinglish_roman: Stomatal pore ka kholna aur band hona guard cells ka kaam hota hai.

original_english: Heterotrophic organisms include animals and fungi which utilise complex substances broken down by enzymes.
hinglish_roman: Heterotrophic organisms mein animals aur fungi aate hain jo enzymes dwara todi gayi complex substances ka upyog karte hain.

original_english: Amoeba takes in food using temporary finger-like extensions of the cell surface which fuse over the food particle forming a food-vacuole.
hinglish_roman: Amoeba apni cell surface ke temporary finger-jaisi extensions se khaana leta hai jo food particle ke upar fuse hokar ek food-vacuole banati hain.

original_english: Saliva contains an enzyme called salivary amylase that breaks down starch into simple sugar.
hinglish_roman: Saliva mein salivary amylase naam ka ek enzyme hota hai jo starch ko simple sugar mein tod deta hai.

original_english: The food is mixed thoroughly with saliva and moved around the mouth while chewing by the muscular tongue.
hinglish_roman: Khaana saliva ke saath achhi tarah mix hota hai aur chewing ke dauran muscular tongue dwara mooh mein ghumaya jaata hai.

original_english: Peristaltic movements occur all along the gut to push food forward in a regulated manner.
hinglish_roman: Peristaltic movements poori gut mein hoti hain jo khaane ko regulate karke aage dhakela karti hain.

original_english: Gastric glands in the stomach release hydrochloric acid, pepsin, and mucus.
hinglish_roman: Stomach ki wall mein maujood gastric glands hydrochloric acid, pepsin, aur mucus release karti hain.

original_english: The small intestine is the site of complete digestion of carbohydrates, proteins and fats.
hinglish_roman: Small intestine woh jagah hai jahan carbohydrates, proteins aur fats ka poora digestion hota hai.

original_english: Bile juice from the liver acts on fats, breaking them into smaller globules to increase the efficiency of enzyme action.
hinglish_roman: Liver se aane wala bile juice fats par kaam karta hai, unhe chhote globules mein tod ke enzyme action ki efficiency badhata hai.

original_english: Villi are finger-like projections on the inner lining of the small intestine that increase the surface area for absorption.
hinglish_roman: Villi small intestine ki inner lining par finger-jaisi projections hain jo absorption ke liye surface area badhati hain.

original_english: The large intestine absorbs more water from the undigested food before it is excreted through the anus.
hinglish_roman: Large intestine undigested khaane se zyada paani absorb karta hai usse anus ke zariye bahar nikalne se pehle.

original_english: The first step of respiration is the break-down of glucose, a six-carbon molecule, into a three-carbon molecule called pyruvate in the cytoplasm.
hinglish_roman: Respiration ka pehla step cytoplasm mein glucose ka, jo ek six-carbon molecule hai, teen-carbon molecule jise pyruvate kehte hain mein tutna hai.

original_english: Anaerobic respiration takes place in the absence of oxygen, converting pyruvate into ethanol and carbon dioxide in yeast.
hinglish_roman: Anaerobic respiration oxygen ki absence mein hoti hai, yeast mein pyruvate ko ethanol aur carbon dioxide mein convert karti hai.

original_english: Aerobic respiration breaks pyruvate in the mitochondria using oxygen to give carbon dioxide, water and energy.
hinglish_roman: Aerobic respiration mitochondria mein oxygen ki madad se pyruvate ko carbon dioxide, paani aur energy mein todti hai.

original_english: The build-up of lactic acid in muscles during sudden activity causes cramps.
hinglish_roman: Achanak activity ke dauran muscles mein lactic acid ka jama hona cramps ka kaaran banta hai.

original_english: ATP is the energy currency for most cellular processes and is synthesised using energy released during respiration.
hinglish_roman: ATP zyaadatar cellular processes ke liye energy currency hai aur respiration ke dauran nikli energy se synthesise hota hai.

original_english: Since the amount of dissolved oxygen in water is less, aquatic organisms breathe at a much faster rate than terrestrial organisms.
hinglish_roman: Kyunki paani mein dissolved oxygen ki matra kam hoti hai, aquatic organisms terrestrial organisms se kaafi tezi se saanste hain.

original_english: In human beings, air is taken into the body through the nostrils, filtered by fine hairs, and passed through the throat into the lungs.
hinglish_roman: Insano mein, hawaain naak ke zariye body mein aati hain, barik baalon se filter hoti hain, aur galey se hote hue lungs mein pahunchti hain.

original_english: The alveoli provide a surface where the exchange of gases can take place and have an extensive network of blood vessels.
hinglish_roman: Alveoli ek aisi surface provide karti hain jahan gases ka exchange hota hai aur inme blood vessels ka ek bada network hota hai.

original_english: Haemoglobin is the respiratory pigment in human beings that has a very high affinity for oxygen and is present in red blood corpuscles.
hinglish_roman: Haemoglobin insano mein respiratory pigment hai jisko oxygen se bahut zyada affinity hoti hai aur yeh red blood corpuscles mein hota hai.

original_english: Blood consists of a fluid medium called plasma in which the cells are suspended.
hinglish_roman: Blood mein plasma naam ka ek fluid medium hota hai jisme cells suspend rehte hain.

original_english: The heart has different chambers to prevent oxygen-rich blood from mixing with blood containing carbon dioxide.
hinglish_roman: Heart mein alag alag chambers hote hain taaki oxygen-rich blood, carbon dioxide wale blood se mix na ho sake.

original_english: The left atrium collects oxygen-rich blood from the lungs and transfers it to the left ventricle which pumps it to the body.
hinglish_roman: Left atrium lungs se oxygen-rich blood collect karta hai aur use left ventricle mein transfer karta hai jo use poore body mein pump karta hai.

original_english: Double circulation means blood passes through the heart twice during each cycle of passage through the body.
hinglish_roman: Double circulation ka matlab hai ki blood body mein ek chakkar lagane mein heart se do baar guzarta hai.

original_english: Arteries are thick-walled elastic vessels that carry blood away from the heart under high pressure.
hinglish_roman: Arteries thick-walled elastic naaliyan hoti hain jo blood ko heart se zyada pressure mein dur le jaati hain.

original_english: Veins have valves that ensure blood flows only in one direction back to the heart.
hinglish_roman: Veins mein valves hote hain jo ensure karte hain ki blood sirf ek hi direction mein heart ki taraf bahta rahe.

original_english: Capillaries are the smallest blood vessels with one-cell thick walls across which exchange of material between blood and cells occurs.
hinglish_roman: Capillaries sabse chhhoti blood vessels hoti hain jinki walls ek cell ki moti hoti hain aur jinke zariye blood aur cells ke beech material ka exchange hota hai.

original_english: Platelets are blood cells that help clot blood at points of injury to minimise blood loss.
hinglish_roman: Platelets blood cells hote hain jo injury wali jagah par blood ko clot karne mein madad karte hain taaki blood loss kam ho.

original_english: Lymph carries digested and absorbed fat from the intestine and drains excess fluid from extra cellular space back into the blood.
hinglish_roman: Lymph intestine se digested aur absorbed fat le jaata hai aur extra cellular space se zyada fluid ko wapas blood mein drain karta hai.

original_english: Plants have two transport systems: xylem moves water and minerals from soil, while phloem transports food from leaves.
hinglish_roman: Plants mein do transport systems hote hain: xylem mitti se paani aur minerals le jaata hai, jabki phloem patti se khaana transport karta hai.

original_english: Roots actively take up ions from the soil, creating a concentration difference that causes water to move into root xylem.
hinglish_roman: Jadein mitti se ions actively absorb karti hain, ek concentration difference create karke jo paani ko root xylem mein jaane par majboor karta hai.

original_english: Transpiration is the loss of water in the form of vapour from the aerial parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Transpiration plant ke upar wale hisson se paani ka vapour ke roop mein khojaana hai.

original_english: Translocation of food occurs in the phloem using energy from ATP, increasing osmotic pressure to move material.
hinglish_roman: Khaane ka translocation phloem mein ATP ki energy use karke hota hai, jo osmotic pressure badhata hai aur material ko move karta hai.

original_english: Excretion is the biological process involved in the removal of harmful metabolic wastes from the body.
hinglish_roman: Excretion woh biological process hai jisme body se haanikaarak metabolic wastes nikale jaate hain.

original_english: The human excretory system includes a pair of kidneys, ureters, a urinary bladder and a urethra.
hinglish_roman: Insani excretory system mein ek jodi kidneys, ureters, ek urinary bladder aur ek urethra hoti hai.

original_english: Urine is produced in the kidneys to filter out waste products like urea and uric acid from the blood.
hinglish_roman: Urine kidneys mein banta hai taaki blood se urea aur uric acid jaisi waste products filter out ho sakein.

original_english: Each kidney has a large number of filtration units called nephrons packed close together.
hinglish_roman: Har kidney mein bahut saari filtration units hoti hain jinhe nephrons kehte hain jo ek saath close pack hoti hain.

original_english: Glucose, amino acids, salts and water are selectively reabsorbed as urine flows along the kidney tubule.
hinglish_roman: Glucose, amino acids, salts aur paani selectively reabsorb ho jaate hain jab urine kidney tubule se guzarti hai.

original_english: An artificial kidney removes nitrogenous waste products from the blood through the process of dialysis.
hinglish_roman: Artificial kidney dialysis ki process ke zariye blood se nitrogenous waste products hatati hai.

original_english: Plants can get rid of excess water through transpiration and some waste products are stored in cell vacuoles.
hinglish_roman: Plants transpiration ke zariye zyada paani se chhutkaara pa sakti hain aur kuch waste products cell vacuoles mein store hoti hain.

original_english: Some plant waste products are stored as resins and gums in old xylem, while others are excreted into the surrounding soil.
hinglish_roman: Kuch plant waste products purane xylem mein resins aur gums ke roop mein store hote hain, jabki kuch aas paas ki mitti mein excrete ho jaate hain.

original_english: Viruses do not show any molecular movement until they infect a cell, which is partly why there is controversy about whether they are alive.
hinglish_roman: Viruses kisi cell ko infect karne tak koi molecular movement nahi dikhate, isliye yeh controversy hai ki woh sach mein alive hain ya nahi.

original_english: Single-celled organisms do not need specific organs for taking in food or exchanging gases because their entire surface is in contact with the environment.
hinglish_roman: Single-celled organisms ko khaana lene ya gases exchange karne ke liye alag organs ki zaroorat nahi kyunki unki puri surface environment ke sampark mein hoti hai.

original_english: The pancreas secretes pancreatic juice containing enzymes like trypsin for proteins and lipase for fats.
hinglish_roman: Pancreas pancreatic juice secrete karta hai jisme trypsin jaisi enzymes proteins ke liye aur lipase fats ke liye hoti hain.

original_english: Blood pressure is the force that blood exerts against the wall of a vessel and is measured using a sphygmomanometer.
hinglish_roman: Blood pressure woh force hai jo blood vessel ki wall ke khilaf lagata hai aur ise sphygmomanometer se measure kiya jaata hai.

original_english: Normal systolic pressure is about 120 mm of Hg and diastolic pressure is 80 mm of Hg.
hinglish_roman: Normal systolic pressure lagbhag 120 mm Hg hota hai aur diastolic pressure 80 mm Hg hota hai.

original_english: Hypertension is caused by constriction of arterioles, increasing resistance to blood flow and can lead to rupture of an artery.
hinglish_roman: Hypertension arterioles ke sikadte rehne ki wajah se hota hai, blood flow ka resistance badhata hai aur artery ke phatne ka khatra ban jaata hai.

original_english: In fishes, the heart has only two chambers and blood is pumped to the gills where it is oxygenated before going to the body.
hinglish_roman: Machchliyon mein heart mein sirf do chambers hote hain aur blood pehle gills mein pump hota hai jahan oxygenate hota hai phir body mein jaata hai.

original_english: Nitrogen is an essential element for plants, taken up as inorganic nitrates or nitrites, or as organic compounds prepared by bacteria.
hinglish_roman: Nitrogen plants ke liye ek zaroori element hai, jo inorganic nitrates ya nitrites ke roop mein, ya bacteria dwara bane organic compounds ke roop mein liya jaata hai.

original_english: Parasitic nutrition is used by organisms like cuscuta, ticks, lice, leeches and tapeworms that derive nutrition without killing the host.
hinglish_roman: Parasitic nutrition cuscuta, ticks, lice, joonk aur tapeworms jaisi organisms use karti hain jo host ko maare bina nutrition lete hain.

original_english: Herbivores have longer small intestines to digest cellulose, while carnivores have shorter ones because meat is easier to digest.
hinglish_roman: Herbivores ki small intestine lambi hoti hai cellulose digest karne ke liye, jabki carnivores ki chhhoti hoti hai kyunki maas digest karna aasaan hota hai.

original_english: Amphibians and many reptiles have three-chambered hearts and tolerate some mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood.
hinglish_roman: Amphibians aur kaafi reptiles ke teen-chambered heart hote hain aur yeh oxygenated aur deoxygenated blood ke thode mixing ko sahte hain.

original_english: During the day, CO2 generated during respiration is used up for photosynthesis so no CO2 is released.
hinglish_roman: Din ke dauran, respiration mein bana CO2 photosynthesis ke liye istemal ho jaata hai isliye koi CO2 bahar nahi nikalta.

original_english: The mucus in the stomach protects the inner lining from the action of hydrochloric acid under normal conditions.
hinglish_roman: Stomach mein maujood mucus normal conditions mein inner lining ko hydrochloric acid ke asar se bachata hai.

original_english: Transpiration pull becomes the major driving force for movement of water in xylem during the day when stomata are open.
hinglish_roman: Din mein jab stomata khule hote hain, transpiration pull xylem mein paani ke movement ki sabse badi driving force ban jaati hai.

original_english: The sphincter muscle at the exit of the stomach releases food in small amounts into the small intestine.
hinglish_roman: Stomach ke bahar wali jagah par sphincter muscle thodi thodi matra mein khaana small intestine mein release karta hai.

original_english: Carbon dioxide is more soluble in water than oxygen and is mostly transported in dissolved form in blood.
hinglish_roman: Carbon dioxide oxygen se zyada paani mein soluble hoti hai isliye blood mein zyaadatar dissolved form mein transport hoti hai.

original_english: If diffusion were used to move oxygen, it would take 3 years for a molecule to travel from the lungs to the toes.
hinglish_roman: Agar oxygen ke liye diffusion ka use kiya jaata, toh lungs se paon tak pahunchne mein ek molecule ko 3 saal lagte.

original_english: The alveolar surface if spread out would cover about 80 square metres, making gas exchange very efficient.
hinglish_roman: Agar alveolar surface ko failaaya jaaye toh woh lagbhag 80 square metres cover karegi, jisse gas exchange bahut efficient ho jaati hai.

original_english: In spring, sugar stored in root or stem tissue is transported to the buds which need energy to grow.
hinglish_roman: Basant mein, jadon ya tane mein store hue sugar ko buds tak pahunchaya jaata hai jinhe barhne ke liye energy chahiye hoti hai.

original_english: Dental caries begin when bacteria acting on sugars produce acids that soften or demineralise the enamel.
hinglish_roman: Dental caries tab shuru hoti hain jab bacteria sugar par asar karke aise acids banate hain jo enamel ko soft ya demineralise kar dete hain.

original_english: Urine is stored in the urinary bladder until pressure leads to the urge to pass it out through the urethra.
hinglish_roman: Urine urinary bladder mein tab tak store rehti hai jab tak pressure se urethra ke zariye bahar karne ki ichha na ho.

original_english: In a healthy adult, the initial filtrate in the kidneys is about 180 litres daily, but only 1 to 2 litres are actually excreted.
hinglish_roman: Ek healthy adult mein kidneys mein roz lagbhag 180 litre filtrate banta hai, lekin asli mein sirf 1 se 2 litre hi excrete hota hai.

original_english: The guard cells swell when water flows into them, causing the stomatal pore to open.
hinglish_roman: Guard cells mein jab paani jaata hai toh woh phool jaate hain, jisse stomatal pore khul jaata hai.

original_english: Organ donation involves surgically removing an organ from a donor and transplanting it to a recipient whose organ has failed.
hinglish_roman: Organ donation mein ek donor se organ surgically nikala jaata hai aur ek aisi vyakti ko transplant kiya jaata hai jiska organ kaam karna band ho gaya ho.

original_english: Plants use the fact that many of their tissues consist of dead cells and they can even lose parts like leaves to get rid of waste.
hinglish_roman: Plants is baat ka faayda uthate hain ki unke kai tissues dead cells se bane hain aur woh waste se chhutkaara paane ke liye patte jaisi cheezein bhi gira sakte hain.

original_english: The right ventricle pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs for oxygenation after receiving it from the right atrium.
hinglish_roman: Right ventricle right atrium se deoxygenated blood lekar use oxygenation ke liye lungs mein pump karta hai.

original_english: Birds and mammals maintain constant body temperature using energy, which is why they need efficient double circulation.
hinglish_roman: Pakshi aur mammals energy use karke apna body temperature constant rakhte hain, isliye unhe efficient double circulation ki zaroorat hoti hai.

original_english: Autotrophs make their own food using carbon dioxide and water.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs apna food khud banate hain carbon dioxide aur water use karke.

original_english: Photosynthesis converts carbon dioxide and water into carbohydrates in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll.
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis mein carbon dioxide aur water, sunlight aur chlorophyll ki presence mein carbohydrates mein convert hote hain.

original_english: Extra carbohydrates are stored in plants as starch.
hinglish_roman: Extra carbohydrates plant mein starch ke form mein store hote hain.

original_english: Stomata are tiny pores on the leaf surface that allow gas exchange.
hinglish_roman: Stomata leaf ki surface par tiny pores hote hain jo gas exchange allow karte hain.

original_english: Guard cells control the opening and closing of stomata.
hinglish_roman: Guard cells stomata ke opening aur closing ko control karte hain.

original_english: Plants close their stomata to reduce water loss.
hinglish_roman: Plants stomata ko band kar dete hain water loss kam karne ke liye.

original_english: Nitrogen taken up from soil is used to synthesise proteins in plants.
hinglish_roman: Soil se liya gaya nitrogen plants mein proteins synthesise karne ke liye use hota hai.

original_english: Autotrophs synthesise their own food from carbon dioxide and water. This process is called photosynthesis.
hinglish_roman: Yeh organisms apna khud ka food bana lete hain. This process is called photosynthesis.

original_english: Water is absorbed by roots from the soil. This water then moves upward through the plant.
hinglish_roman: Paani roots dwara soil se liya jaata hai. This water then moves upward through the plant.

original_english: Some carbohydrates are used immediately. The remaining ones are stored as starch.
hinglish_roman: Kuch carbohydrates turant use ho jaate hain. The remaining ones are stored as starch.

original_english: What is needed for photosynthesis?
hinglish_roman: Sir, photosynthesis ke liye kya kya chahiye hota hai?

original_english: What are stomata and what is their function?
hinglish_roman: Stomata kya hote hain aur kya kaam karte hain?

original_english: How do guard cells control the stomata?
hinglish_roman: Guard cells stomata ko kaise control karte hain?

original_english: Give an example of autotrophic nutrition.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophic nutrition ka koi example dijiye.

original_english: Saliva contains an enzyme called salivary amylase that breaks down starch into sugar.
hinglish_roman: Saliva mein ek enzyme hota hai jise salivary amylase kehte hain jo starch ko sugar mein break down karta hai.

original_english: The stomach wall releases hydrochloric acid and the enzyme pepsin.
hinglish_roman: Stomach ki wall hydrochloric acid aur pepsin enzyme release karti hai.

original_english: Mucus protects the stomach lining from the acid.
hinglish_roman: Mucus stomach ki lining ko acid se protect karta hai.

original_english: Bile from the liver breaks down large fat globules into smaller ones.
hinglish_roman: Liver se bile fat ke bade globules ko chhote globules mein todta hai.

original_english: The pancreas secretes enzymes like trypsin and lipase into the small intestine.
hinglish_roman: Pancreas small intestine mein trypsin aur lipase jaise enzymes secrete karta hai.

original_english: Villi in the small intestine increase the surface area for absorption.
hinglish_roman: Small intestine ke villi absorption ke liye surface area badhate hain.

original_english: Herbivores have a longer small intestine to digest cellulose.
hinglish_roman: Herbivores ki small intestine lambi hoti hai taaki cellulose digest ho sake.

original_english: Autotrophs make their own food from simple materials. Heterotrophs, on the other hand, depend on complex food prepared by others.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs apna food khud simple materials se bana lete hain. Heterotrophs, on the other hand, depend on complex food prepared by others.

original_english: Food is broken into simpler molecules by enzymes. This makes absorption possible in the intestine.
hinglish_roman: Enzymes food ko simple molecules mein todte hain. This makes absorption possible in the intestine.

original_english: Undigested food passes into the large intestine. There, water is absorbed from this remaining material.
hinglish_roman: Jo food digest nahi hota woh large intestine mein chala jaata hai. There, water is absorbed from this remaining material.

original_english: How does saliva break down starch?
hinglish_roman: Saliva starch ko kaise break down karti hai?

original_english: What is the difference between the small intestine of herbivores and carnivores?
hinglish_roman: Herbivores aur carnivores ki small intestine mein kya farak hota hai?

original_english: What is the role of bile in digestion?
hinglish_roman: Bile ka kya kaam hota hai digestion mein?

original_english: How do villi improve absorption?
hinglish_roman: Villi absorption ko kaise improve karte hain?

original_english: Glucose breaks down into pyruvate in the cytoplasm of the cell.
hinglish_roman: Glucose cell ke cytoplasm mein pyruvate mein break down hota hai.

original_english: In yeast, pyruvate is converted into ethanol and carbon dioxide during fermentation.
hinglish_roman: Yeast mein pyruvate fermentation ke dauran ethanol aur carbon dioxide mein convert ho jaata hai.

original_english: Aerobic respiration takes place in the mitochondria using oxygen.
hinglish_roman: Aerobic respiration mitochondria mein oxygen use karke hoti hai.

original_english: Lack of oxygen in muscles causes pyruvate to convert into lactic acid.
hinglish_roman: Muscles mein oxygen ki kami hone par pyruvate lactic acid mein convert ho jaata hai.

original_english: The energy released during respiration is used to make ATP.
hinglish_roman: Respiration ke dauran release hone wali energy ATP banane mein use hoti hai.

original_english: Alveoli provide a large surface area for the exchange of gases.
hinglish_roman: Alveoli gases ke exchange ke liye ek bada surface area provide karte hain.

original_english: Haemoglobin in red blood cells carries oxygen to all body tissues.
hinglish_roman: Red blood cells mein haemoglobin sabhi body tissues tak oxygen le jaata hai.

original_english: Aerobic respiration releases a large amount of energy. In comparison, anaerobic respiration releases much less energy.
hinglish_roman: Aerobic respiration mein bahut zyada energy release hoti hai. In comparison, anaerobic respiration releases much less energy.

original_english: Fish breathe using gills to absorb dissolved oxygen from water. This is because the amount of oxygen dissolved in water is much lower than in air.
hinglish_roman: Machli gills ke through paani mein dissolved oxygen lete hain. This is because the amount of oxygen dissolved in water is much lower than in air.

original_english: During the day, plants use up the carbon dioxide produced during respiration. At night, however, carbon dioxide release becomes the major activity.
hinglish_roman: Din mein plants respiration se bana carbon dioxide use kar lete hain. At night, however, carbon dioxide release becomes the major activity.

original_english: What is the difference between aerobic and anaerobic respiration?
hinglish_roman: Aerobic aur anaerobic respiration mein kya fark hai?

original_english: Why do cramps occur in muscles after sudden activity?
hinglish_roman: Muscles mein cramps kyun hote hain sudden activity ke baad?

original_english: What is ATP and what is its role in the cell?
hinglish_roman: ATP kya hota hai aur cell mein iska kya role hai?

original_english: How are alveoli designed for gas exchange?
hinglish_roman: Alveoli gas exchange ke liye kaise design hote hain?

original_english: The heart has different chambers to keep oxygenated and deoxygenated blood separate.
hinglish_roman: Heart mein alag alag chambers hote hain taaki oxygenated aur deoxygenated blood mix na ho.

original_english: The left ventricle pumps oxygen-rich blood to the whole body.
hinglish_roman: Left ventricle oxygen-rich blood ko poore body mein pump karta hai.

original_english: Arteries carry blood away from the heart under high pressure.
hinglish_roman: Arteries heart se blood ko high pressure ke saath door le jaati hain.

original_english: Valves in veins prevent the backward flow of blood.
hinglish_roman: Veins mein valves blood ko backward flow hone se rokte hain.

original_english: Platelets help clot the blood at the site of an injury.
hinglish_roman: Platelets injury wali jagah par blood ko clot karne mein help karte hain.

original_english: Xylem transports water and minerals from roots to the leaves.
hinglish_roman: Xylem paani aur minerals ko roots se leaves tak transport karta hai.

original_english: Phloem uses energy from ATP to transport food to different parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Phloem ATP ki energy use karke food ko plant ke alag alag parts mein transport karta hai.

original_english: Fishes have only two heart chambers. Blood passes through their heart only once during one cycle.
hinglish_roman: Machli ke heart mein sirf do chambers hote hain. Blood passes through their heart only once during one cycle.

original_english: Transpiration pulls water upward through the xylem. This process also helps in regulating the temperature of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Transpiration xylem ke through paani ko upar ki taraf khinchta hai. This process also helps in regulating the temperature of the plant.

original_english: Reptiles have three-chambered hearts and allow some mixing of blood. Birds and mammals, however, need complete separation because of their high energy needs.
hinglish_roman: Reptiles ke teen chambers wale heart hote hain jisme thoda mixing hota hai. Birds and mammals, however, need complete separation because of their high energy needs.

original_english: What is the function of xylem and phloem, and how are they different?
hinglish_roman: Xylem aur phloem ka kya kaam hai, dono mein kya farak hai?

original_english: How does blood undergo double circulation in the heart?
hinglish_roman: Heart mein blood double circulation kaise karta hai?

original_english: What is transpiration?
hinglish_roman: Transpiration kya hoti hai?

original_english: What do platelets do at the time of an injury?
hinglish_roman: Platelets injury ke time kya karte hain?

original_english: Kidneys filter nitrogenous waste like urea from the blood.
hinglish_roman: Kidneys blood se urea jaisa nitrogenous waste filter karte hain.

original_english: Each nephron has a Bowman's capsule that collects the filtrate.
hinglish_roman: Har nephron mein ek Bowman's capsule hota hai jo filtrate collect karta hai.

original_english: Useful substances like glucose and water are reabsorbed back into the blood.
hinglish_roman: Glucose aur paani jaisi useful cheezein wapas blood mein reabsorb ho jaati hain.

original_english: Urine passes from the kidneys through the ureters into the urinary bladder.
hinglish_roman: Urine kidneys se ureters ke through urinary bladder mein jaata hai.

original_english: An artificial kidney removes waste from the blood using dialysis.
hinglish_roman: Artificial kidney dialysis use karke blood se waste remove karta hai.

original_english: Plants store waste products in their vacuoles or in leaves that fall off.
hinglish_roman: Plants apne waste products vacuoles mein ya girne wale leaves mein store karte hain.

original_english: Kidney failure can lead to a dangerous build-up of poisonous wastes in the body.
hinglish_roman: Kidney failure hone par body mein poisonous wastes ka dangerous build-up ho sakta hai.

original_english: Human beings remove nitrogenous waste through the kidneys. Plants, in contrast, get rid of waste through leaves, resins, and the soil.
hinglish_roman: Insaan kidneys ke through nitrogenous waste remove karte hain. Plants, in contrast, get rid of waste through leaves, resins, and the soil.

original_english: The bladder is muscular and under nervous control. This is why we can usually control the urge to urinate.
hinglish_roman: Bladder muscular hota hai aur nervous control mein rehta hai. This is why we can usually control the urge to urinate.

original_english: Dialysis fluid has no nitrogenous wastes in it. During dialysis, waste products move from the blood into this fluid by diffusion.
hinglish_roman: Dialysis fluid mein koi nitrogenous waste nahi hota. During dialysis, waste products move from the blood into this fluid by diffusion.

original_english: How does filtration happen in the kidney?
hinglish_roman: Kidney mein filtration kaise hoti hai?

original_english: What is a nephron?
hinglish_roman: Nephron kya hota hai?

original_english: What is the difference between excretion methods in plants and animals?
hinglish_roman: Plants aur animals ke excretion methods mein kya farak hai?

original_english: How does an artificial kidney work?
hinglish_roman: Artificial kidney kaise kaam karti hai?

original_english: Living organisms must constantly repair and maintain their structures using molecular movement. This is because the environment keeps breaking down their organised structure over time.
hinglish_roman: Living organisms ko apni structures ko maintain karne ke liye hamesha molecular movement chahiye. This is because the environment keeps breaking down their organised structure over time.

original_english: Even a sleeping or resting organism continues its maintenance processes. These processes together are called life processes.
hinglish_roman: Sote hue ya rest karte hue organism mein bhi maintenance processes chalte rehte hain. These processes together are called life processes.

original_english: Viruses show no molecular movement until they infect a cell. This is one reason there is a debate about whether viruses are truly alive.
hinglish_roman: Virus tab tak koi molecular movement nahi dikhate jab tak woh kisi cell ko infect nahi karte. This is one reason there is a debate about whether viruses are truly alive.

original_english: Simple diffusion is not enough for multicellular organisms because not all cells are in direct contact with the environment. That is why specialised transport systems are needed.
hinglish_roman: Multicellular organisms mein diffusion akela kaafi nahi hota kyunki saari cells environment ke direct contact mein nahi hoti. That is why specialised transport systems are needed.

original_english: Bacteria can prepare organic nitrogen compounds that plants take up from soil. This nitrogen is essential for making proteins.
hinglish_roman: Bacteria organic nitrogen compounds bana sakte hain jinhe plants soil se lete hain. This nitrogen is essential for making proteins.

original_english: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants make their own food using sunlight.
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis woh process hai jisme plants apna khud ka khana sunlight se banate hain.
hinglish_with_error: Photosynthesis woh process hai jisme plants apna khud ka khana sunlight se banatey hain.
gec_explanation: 'banatey' is a non-standard romanization; the correct Hinglish spelling is 'banate' following standard Hindi transliteration.

original_english: The kidneys filter waste products from the blood and produce urine.
hinglish_roman: Kidneys blood se waste products filter karke urine banate hain.
hinglish_with_error: Kidneys blood se waste products filter karke urine banatey hai.
gec_explanation: 'Kidneys' is plural, so the verb should be 'hain' (plural) not 'hai' (singular) to maintain subject-verb agreement.

original_english: Aerobic respiration takes place in the mitochondria and releases more energy than anaerobic respiration.
hinglish_roman: Aerobic respiration mitochondria mein hoti hai aur anaerobic respiration se zyada energy release karti hai.
hinglish_with_error: Aerobic respiration mitochondria mein hoti hai aur anaerobic respiration se jyada energy realese karti hai.
gec_explanation: 'realese' is a misspelling caused by transposing letters; the correct English spelling is 'release'.

original_english: Villi are present in the small intestine to increase the surface area for absorption of digested food.
hinglish_roman: Villi small intestine mein hote hain jo digested khaane ke absorption ke liye surface area badhate hain.
hinglish_with_error: Villi small intestine mein hota hai jo digested khaane ke absorption ke liye surface area badhate hain.
gec_explanation: 'Villi' is plural, so the verb must agree in number: 'hote hain' (plural) is correct, not 'hota hai' (singular).

original_english: Transpiration is the loss of water from the aerial parts of the plant in the form of vapour.
hinglish_roman: Transpiration plant ke upar wale hisson se vapour ke roop mein paani ka kho jaana hai.
hinglish_with_error: Transpiration plant ke upar wale hisson se vapour ke rup mein paani ka kho jaana hai.
gec_explanation: 'rup' is an informal or truncated spelling; the standard Hinglish transliteration of the Hindi word रूप is 'roop'.

original_english: What is the difference between aerobic and anaerobic respiration?
hinglish_roman: Aerobic aur anaerobic respiration mein kya antar hota hai?

original_english: What is photosynthesis and where does it take place?
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis kya hota hai aur yeh kahan hota hai?

original_english: Why do we need a transport system in our body?
hinglish_roman: Hamare body mein transport system ki zaroorat kyun padti hai?

original_english: Can you give an example of autotrophic nutrition?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap autotrophic nutrition ka ek example de sakte hain?

original_english: What is the role of the kidney in excretion?
hinglish_roman: Excretion mein kidney ka kya role hota hai?

original_english: What is the formula or equation for photosynthesis?
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis ki formula ya equation kya hoti hai?

original_english: How is double circulation different from single circulation?
hinglish_roman: Double circulation aur single circulation mein kya farq hota hai?

original_english: What exactly is a nephron and what does it do?
hinglish_roman: Nephron actually hota kya hai aur yeh kya karta hai?

original_english: Can you explain how xylem is different from phloem?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap explain kar sakte hain ki xylem aur phloem mein kya difference hai?

original_english: Why does lactic acid form in muscles during exercise?
hinglish_roman: Exercise ke dauran muscles mein lactic acid kyun banta hai?

original_english: What is the definition of transpiration?
hinglish_roman: Transpiration ki definition kya hoti hai?

original_english: Can you give an example of a heterotrophic organism and how it gets nutrition?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap ek heterotrophic organism ka example de sakte hain aur yeh nutrition kaise leta hai?

original_english: How do alveoli help in the exchange of gases in the lungs?
hinglish_roman: Alveoli lungs mein gases ke exchange mein kaise help karte hain?

original_english: What is the difference between arteries and veins?
hinglish_roman: Arteries aur veins mein kya antar hota hai?

original_english: What are the raw materials needed for photosynthesis?
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis ke liye kaun se raw materials chahiye hote hain?
